Platform / Facility Mapping

Facility and unit mapping

The physical structure of the service — buildings, units, beds, rooms — is mapped within the system. This enables resident allocation, documentation tracking, and physical reporting.

← Platform

Structure

Organisation

└ Facility

└ Building

└ Unit / Wing

└ Room / Bed

The structure is configured during service setup and can be updated as the facility changes.

Uses

01Allocate residents to specific beds or rooms on admission
02Track occupancy across units and buildings
03Scope incident reports and risk assessments to physical locations
04Generate facility-level compliance reports for inspection
